shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One clear real-world documentary photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner's English review. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain and plausible lighting, realistic anatomy and hands. NOT an illustration, collage, cutout, split panel or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, internal padding, fake blur bands, watermarks, captions, speech bubbles, logos or readable words except an explicitly requested numeral. A first-time learner must recognize the meaning at phone size: the key person, action and object are large, sharp and inside the central safe area. Fresh scenes for this review only; never imitate a previous course photo. Ordinary anonymous people, never the recurring course cast (no Ana, Luis, Sofia or Diego).
